card.statement: Let $X=\mathbb{A}^{2}_{k}$ , and $D,Z$ as in Theorem 2.14. Let $G$ be $\mathrm{GL}_{n}$ , $\mathrm{SL}_{n}$ , $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}$ or a solvable affine algebraic group over $k$ . Then there is a canonical bijection $\mathcal{G}r_{G}^{L}(k)\simeq\underline{\mathbf{Gr}}_{\mathbb{A}^{1},0}^{L}(k)$ .
card.label: Proposition 2.16

paper.title: Two dimensional versions of the affine Grassmannian and their geometric description
paper.abstract: For a smooth affine algebraic group $G$ over an algebraically closed field, we consider several two-variables generalizations of the affine Grassmannian $G(\!(t)\!)/G[\![t]\!]$, given by quotients of the double loop group $G(\!(x)\!)(\!(y)\!)$. We prove that they are representable by ind-schemes if $G$ is solvable. Given a smooth surface $X$ and a flag of subschemes of $X$, we provide a geometric interpretation of the two-variables Grassmannians, in terms of bundles and trivialisation data defined on appropriate loci in $X$, which depend on the flag.
